en: Sepia-toned studio photograph showing a humorous scene: a uniformed guard with a spiked helmet (Pickelhaube) stands beside a striped wooden sentry box, pointing toward its entrance. Opposite him is a woman in a striped dress with apron and bonnet, holding a wicker basket as if delivering items. The background is plain and theatrical, giving the impression of an early 20th‑century staged postcard.
